items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I went up there one fine night with a couple of the boys and I started to play with them

ctx.x: Yeah. That ain't too long ago. Oh, it's about. Oh, yes. That was in the Times-Picayune. Yeah. You were 66 then and he's 85 now. Yeah.

It's been a long time ago. It's been a long time ago. They come and got me to take the picture, Johnny, you know? Yeah. Uh-huh. So, the Finnish Italian, they told this fella that he had no more business to be major in that band. And so, after they heard me, I understand, playing one thing or another, I went up there one fine night with a couple of the boys and I started to play with them, you understand? Jesus, they found it mighty different between before and when I was playing. Yeah. So, Major Violet come to…
Oh, you got to see that.
